title: feat(enter): sign in MCP clients with Client ID Metadata Documents
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: MCP clients can use an HTTPS Client ID Metadata Document URL as `client_id` at `/authorize` instead of registering a `pk_` key; the user still signs in with their own Pollinations account. Enter requires a canonical HTTPS URL on a public host with no credentials or fragment, then fetches a matching document with a 200 response, no redirects, a 5 KB size cap and a 5-second timeout. The document must provide `client_name` and valid `redirect_uris`, with no client secret. Consent shows the client name and host, warns about localhost redirects, and leaves requested `keys` and `machines` scopes unticked. Approval mints the same restricted `sk_` as the existing `pk_` flow, with a default budget of 5, a 7-day expiry and no refresh token. `POST /api/oauth/code` fetches the document again and requires an exact redirect match; `/token` and the `pk_` path are unchanged. `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` now advertises `client_id_metadata_document_supported: true`.
